article.title: Par aspectual решать/решить
article.chapter: Aspecto imperfectivo/perfectivo: fundamentos — Вид глагола: основы

claims.summary: The article explains the aspectual pair решать and решить, which form a pair with senses like 'resolve' and, depending on the context, 'decide'. It describes the imperfective решать as indicating process, repetition or general fact, and the perfective решить as typically presenting a solution or decision as a delimited event.

This section illustrates how решать focuses on the process of resolving, while решить presents the solution as achieved. It provides examples in Russian and English to demonstrate the difference in meaning.

The article gives several examples of решать and решить in context, showing how the aspectual difference affects meaning. These examples are consistent with the explanations and examples given in the Wikipedia article.
